ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A ‘good and knowledgeable person’ is a guide whom practitioners approach, recognize, or are warned to distinguish from a deceptive guide. In Chan records the role is relational: the person directs, tests, or clarifies for someone else.
EvidenceBody: The term occurs 2,832 times in 311 allowlisted texts. Dahui directly says, “those called good teachers guide all beings and cause them to see nature” (夫稱善知識者，引導一切眾生，令見佛性), then describes observing people's capacities and giving teaching as medicine matches illness. He calls such reception and guidance “the proper work a good teacher ought to do” (善知識本分合做底事), and elsewhere mentions “a good teacher's eye for distinguishing people” (善知識辨人眼). The Five Lamps Compendium describes travelling people “visiting good teachers” (參善知識). Another narrative has a student say, “a great good teacher is hard to encounter even across ages; now that I have met one, why begrudge body or life?” (大善知識歷劫難逢，今既得遇，豈惜身命). Asked “what is a good teacher?” (如何是善知識), Fohai replies that lanterns, pillars, cats, and dogs are all called good teachers. The same label supplies the vocative “Good friends!” when speakers address assemblies. Direct address changes who is being hailed, not the lexical kind of label.
